rules.title: Explicit compatibility date
rules.text: Set compatibility_date explicitly in the Wrangler config and update it deliberately after testing.

rules.title: Generate binding types
rules.text: Generate binding types with wrangler types, and run wrangler types --check in CI so Env stays current.

rules.title: Secrets via Wrangler
rules.text: Store secrets with wrangler secret, never in vars or in the repository.

rules.title: Use bindings
rules.text: Access resources through bindings on env, not through globals or hard-coded URLs.

rules.title: nodejs_compat when needed
rules.text: Add the nodejs_compat flag when you need Node.js built-ins, and import them with the node: prefix.

rules.title: wrangler.jsonc with schema
rules.text: Prefer wrangler.jsonc and include the $schema entry so editors validate the config.

rules.title: Durable Object migrations
rules.text: Declare each Durable Object class with a migration entry, using new_sqlite_classes for SQLite-backed objects.

rules.title: Hyperdrive for Postgres
rules.text: Use Hyperdrive for pooled access to external Postgres from Workers.

rules.title: No per-request globals
rules.text: Do not keep per-request state in module globals. Isolates are reused across requests.

rules.title: Background work
rules.text: Use ctx.waitUntil for work that may finish after the response, and keep handlers within CPU and memory limits.

rules.title: Develop locally
rules.text: Develop with wrangler dev or Miniflare, and do not depend on production bindings in tests.

rules.title: Shared dev behavior
rules.text: Implement local development features in the shared simulator so Wrangler, the Vite plugin and the Vitest plugin all benefit.
